Name: Simple Insignia - Companion Annabelle - Bounty And Contracts
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]✦ Simple Insignia ✦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Meet [/color][b][color=#D8B4FE]Annabelle[/color][/b][color=#D8B4FE], a curious, cheeky, purple-haired apparition who brings company to your farm. Build a friendship, hear her reactions to life in the valley and turn your everyday activities into rewarding little adventures.[/color][/size][/center]



[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Meet [b]Annabelle[/b], a curious, cheeky, purple-haired apparition who brings company to your farm. Build a friendship, hear her reactions to life in the valley and turn your everyday activities into rewarding little adventures.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]✨ Annabelle at Your Side[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]A companion with personality:[/b] following, optional roaming and contextual comments about your activities, surroundings and remembered visits. She also comments after your first completed conversation with each villager, with named fallback remarks for unfamiliar modded characters.
• [b]Friendship and style:[/b] talk, offer gifts and choose outfits or her floating Spirit form through the wardrobe. Five friendship stories unlock at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 hearts. Her birthday is Fall 27.
• [b]Portrait choice:[/b] optional Classic Stardew Valley portraits have twelve expressions, rebuilt from her neutral portrait with improved HD rendering. Classic portraits are Off by default.
• [b]A favourite treat:[/b] Nesquik Powder and Hot Chocolate Nesquik have special gift reactions and animated item icons. At two hearts, read her letter to learn the drink recipe and unlock powder at Pierre’s.[/color][/size][/center]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53823/53823-1791947206-1321030470.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]💜 Annabelle - Someone to Share the Valley With[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Annabelle brings a voice and a personality to the little moments between your goals. A rainy walk, a stubborn fish, a trip into the mines or a quiet evening at home can give her something to say. Her authored dialogue responds to supported situations around you, helping everyday routines feel like experiences you are sharing with a companion.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#7DD3FC]🌦️ A Companion Who Notices the World[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Her ambient chatter takes account of the time, weather and surroundings. Early mornings, late nights, rain, thunderstorms and outdoor winter days have their own remarks. The farm, farmhouse, animal buildings, sheds, town, beach, woods and mines give her different things to notice, so a walk across the Valley can feel different from an afternoon at home.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F5CC7A]🌱 Reactions to Your Actual Adventures[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Annabelle can react to supported activities and their outcomes: watering, planting, harvesting, felling trees, catching or losing fish, finding fishing treasure, shopping, petting animals and moments of danger. She also has comments for low health, low energy and staying out late. These reactions connect her conversation to what has happened, rather than making every remark feel interchangeable.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]✨ A Personality Beyond Small Talk[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]She can be proud, playful and wonderfully dramatic, but there is a softer side beneath her royal confidence. Personal conversations and friendship-gated lines let her reveal more of herself as you grow closer. Occasional vulnerable remarks give quieter moments room to matter, alongside the teasing and everyday chatter.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#86EFAC]🗺️ Familiar Places and People[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Supported encounter and visit memories help her acknowledge parts of your shared journey. She has character-specific remarks for recognized villagers, with additional dialogue for supported Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village characters when their mods are installed and encounter conditions are met. This is written support for particular people and situations, not a promise that she recognizes every custom NPC or event.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#7DD3FC]💬 Company While You Play[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]World speech bubbles let her comment while you explore. She also has optional menu chatter for supported screens, including inventory, skills, the map, shops and chests. Talk to her directly when you want a conversation, or let her remarks accompany your normal routine. Cooldowns and recent-line tracking help space out eligible comments and reduce repetition; not every action produces a line.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F5CC7A]⚙️ Set the Pace of Her Chatter[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Adjust speech timing and reading time, and control world, area, activity and menu comments separately. Fourth-wall remarks and dialogue copied to chat are optional too. You can keep her lively, quieten particular kinds of chatter, or give yourself more time to read.[/size][/center]

[center][color=#67E8F9][b][size=5]📜[/size][size=6] Bounties & Contracts[/size][/b][/color][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Three daily adventures[/b] track work such as fishing, farming, foraging, mining and combat. Complete the goals and claim gold and skill XP. You keep the fish you catch and perform the activities yourself; Annabelle records your progress.[/color][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53823/53823-1791941476-1932531696.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Weekly challenges[/b] cover Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining, Combat and Living. The journal shows the task, progress and reward; eligible catch-up challenges and limited refreshes provide extra choices.[/color][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53823/53823-1791941492-469780231.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Seasonal milestones[/b] add ten reward tiers for each of the five work skills. Build up progress over the season, earn trophies and look back at past seasons in the archive.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📍 How to Meet Annabelle[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]1. Visit [b]Old Master Cannoli’s statue in the Secret Woods[/b]. The mod opens the vanilla entrance for this introduction; an upgraded axe or Sweet Gem Berry is not needed.
2. Interact with the statue and close its normal dialogue. Complete her introduction to receive the Insignia.
3. Open the journal with [b]K[/b] or its button on the normal backpack Inventory tab.
4. Finish the introductory sample: [b]catch five fish with a rod[/b] for [b]100g + 50 Fishing XP[/b]. They do not need to be different species. The journal explains when your regular activity cycle begins.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b][color=#D8B4FE]🎁 Annabelle’s Gift Tastes[/color][/b][/color][/size]


[size=5][color=#67E8F9][b][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Loved: all flower-category gifts; Chocolate Cake, Pink Cake, Rhubarb Pie, Cookie, Ice Cream, Blueberry Tart, Plum Pudding, Pumpkin Pie, Blackberry Cobbler, regular Milk, Nesquik Powder and Hot Chocolate Nesquik.
Liked: fruit and vegetables, except the explicit dislikes below.
Neutral: Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso, Green Tea and Tea Leaves. Other unmatched eligible gifts, including unclassified modded items, are neutral. Examples include ordinary eggs, bread, rice, wheat flour, oil, vinegar, wood, stone, clay, fibre, ores and bars. Regular Milk remains loved.
Disliked: raw fish (fish-category items), bait, Seaweed, Green Algae, White Algae, Bug Meat, Beer, Pale Ale, Mead, Wine, Garlic, Wild Horseradish and Void Mayonnaise.
Hated: Trash, Driftwood, Broken Glasses, Broken CD, Soggy Newspaper, Slime, Bat Wing, Solar Essence, Void Essence, Red Mushroom and Holly; other junk-category and monster-loot-category items too. Bug Meat is an explicit dislike exception.[/color][/size][/b][/color][/size]


[size=5][color=#67E8F9][b][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Specific exceptions take priority over broad categories, and existing loved gifts remain loved. Modded gifts with recognized categories follow those rules; names alone are not used to guess a taste. These preferences apply to Annabelle’s companion gift menu, not other villagers.
Neutral +20; liked +45; loved +80; disliked -20; hated -40. Quality improves positive values; penalties stay fixed. One gift a day, two a week. Neutral, disliked and hated birthday presents get matching dialogue.[/color][/size][/b][/color][/size]
[size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]
⚙ Make Her Company Your Own[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu keeps the settings in [b]one scrolling menu[/b]. Adjust dialogue categories, bubbles, overlap transparency, roaming, automatic games, animal cameos and movement. Following distance starts at [b]4 tiles[/b] and reaches [b]8[/b]. Chat mirroring, right-click talking and automatic reward claiming default Off; the introductory sample is always claimed manually.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎨 Sprite Artists Welcome![/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]I could use a hand creating a polished in-game sprite and animations for Annabelle, especially with clothing and pose alignment. If you make Stardew Valley sprites and would like to help, you’re very welcome to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Xsyy]message me[/url]. I’d really appreciate it! :D[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The standard sprite remains available. [b]Experimental sprite[/b] is optional and Off by default; some experimental outfits still distort or misalign.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🛠 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53536]Simple Town Chatter[/url] are optional.
Extract [b]SimpleInsignia[/b] into your Mods folder and launch through SMAPI. Run [b]only one Annabelle edition[/b]: Public, Private or the older Simple Ancient Guardian. For updates, close the game, retain config.json and replace this mod’s runtime files.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]💡 Public Edition Notes[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Single-player only.[/b] The public Companion panel contains Roaming and Chatter; manual Play and Stories tabs are removed. The five heart cutscenes are currently disabled, while the introduction, friendship, personal requests and five automatic side stories remain. Expanded localization and some gift-guide categories are still unfinished.[/color][/size]



[size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🚧 Work in Progress — Feedback Welcome[/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Simple Insignia is an unfinished work in progress and still needs testing, polish and improvement. I've shared it early to help uncover bugs and gather feedback. Some features and artwork are incomplete, so you may encounter issues. Bug reports and suggestions are very welcome—thank you for helping me improve Annabelle![/color][/size]

[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a report or suggestion on this mod's page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]For bug reports, please include:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]• Mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform.
• What happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce it.
• A [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], if applicable.
• A screenshot or short video, if helpful.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]For suggestions:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]Tell me what you would like added or changed and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
